confidence: High that Vincent is the intended strongest-case answer; moderate that he actually did it on the evidence alone; no logical certainty. The decisive inventory assertion appears inside his own monologue and identifies material construction, not a proven unique physical fit.
logical_certainty: Not established. Other suspects' exclusive first-entry, only-visit, route, custody and alibi assertions are not all independently shown in full. Plain-backed or supplier-printed red material does not exclude separate poison transfer or disposal. Vincent's foil scrap could have an innocent or planted history, as Evidence 5 explicitly permits. Even a unique match establishes contact more readily than intentional poisoning.
strongest_case_inference: Vincent uniquely admits the visible conjunction: presence in walkthrough with portable wallet, later unwrapped-glass handling, and foil-backed red scrap of the same construction as bottle seal. His humiliation grievance supplies motive. This is much stronger than generic alternate theories but remains inference.
plausibility_notes: Final naturalism verdict: coherent themed conflicts at the local level, visibly engineered as a whole. The draft reads like a logic grid with stylish dialogue pasted over its exclusion categories.

The five west-return speeches, five embossing speeches, three intact-package speeches and four first-arrival speeches become conspicuous families. Repeated only-once/no-second-visit clauses telegraph the intended constraint system.

Characters repeatedly notice raised letters by touch, embossing placement, sewn logos versus sticker seams, and reverse surfaces. Such attention is unlikely across many ordinary gala conversations unless characters already know the exact puzzle tests.
Why a museum receiving desk begins stamping these disparate original documents at 6:45 during a gala is unexplained. The fixed start time feels invented to sort late meetings.
Conservator diversion, unsupervised actual cyanide, negligent return and exact glass custody gap remain major convenient mechanisms.

Vincent volunteers every decisive fact in a compressed final speech: unwrapped glass, embroidered placemat, wallet carried between both areas, matching foil scrap, glass movement. That resembles a required clue bundle more than a suspect's natural defense.
Other material explanations are plausible individually, but paper without foil is not forensic exoneration and touch limited to stem/base is not proof against contamination.
Distinct performances, labor disputes and contested provenance create usable party roles, but polished sarcastic voice and repetitive paperwork remain strong authorial uniformity.

Final difficulty: medium bookkeeping burden, low conceptual difficulty once Method is visible. The sole foil-backed red-scrap owner is pointed enough that an attentive player can identify the intended answer quickly. If literal logical certainty is demanded, difficulty becomes unfairly underdetermined rather than satisfyingly hard.
The strongest inference is clear without inspecting any private culprit information. No claim of a formally unique solution is warranted under the supplied rules.
